auth.selected: Admin-created Hightouch API key resolved only by the trusted bearer connection adapter

source_decision.reason: Hightouch destinations, sources, models, syncs, identity-resolution runs, campaigns, decision flows, messages, and event contracts are reverse-ETL, data-activation, job, or administration resources. The official contract does not prove a canonical task, note, or user-work project Source with a durable version and honest deletion or tombstone model.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Hightouch API keys must be Admin-created and provide read/write access to sensitive workspace resources.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Uses one encrypted bearer connection requirement, exposes no credential operation arguments, requires approval on every mutation, and keeps provider outputs private.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Destination and source contracts can return connection configuration, while model contracts can return compiled or raw SQL.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Retains the capabilities admitted but suppresses all six sensitive GETs from bundled rendering workflows and labels all twelve affected responses as sensitive.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Trigger operations can send campaigns or messages, synchronize data to downstream destinations, or start identity resolution and reprocessing.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Classifies all eight trigger, run, and queue POSTs as destructive and non-idempotent, requires approval every run, and configures no hidden retry.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The official OpenAPI models several numeric identifiers as number/double, which JavaScript cannot preserve exactly at large magnitudes.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Exposes every numeric identifier parameter as a validated decimal string, accepts exact integer strings in response schemas, and enables unsafe-integer string parsing on every response.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Nine collection routes expose caller limit and offset fields that would conflict with automatic traversal, and identity-run listing defaults to 20 while the other eight default to 100.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Removes caller control of limit and offset, uses the exact documented default per route, advances offset by page size, and extracts data.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Four trigger endpoints document optional JSON bodies, while fourteen create or update endpoints require a body.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Preserves the official distinction: optional body_raw can be omitted without sending a body, while required body_raw is schema-required; all payloads are bounded and verbatim.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Twenty-one operations document HTTP 200 as a union of success and provider error envelopes.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Preserves all documented union branches in response schemas, warns callers and workflows to inspect the payload, and lets paginated result-path extraction fail closed when data is absent.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Model tags are a repeated query parameter rather than a comma-joined scalar.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Admits tags as a bounded string array so the connection adapter emits one query occurrence per item.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The official OpenAPI and API guide are mutable web authorities.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Hash-locks the complete OpenAPI and a deterministic normalized API-guide section; generation fails closed on byte, digest, identity, auth, inventory, or evidence drift.

audit_findings_folded.finding: POST /id_graphs/{graphId}/trigger is explicitly deprecated and the contract directs callers to POST /idr/{graphId}/trigger.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Inventories the deprecated route but excludes it from the callable catalog; the documented TriggerIdrRun replacement retains the complete capability.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Hightouch control-plane and job resources resemble work objects but lack honest canonical task, note, or user-work project semantics and deletion evidence.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Declares no work_entity_sources and records the semantic rejection in this fixture.
